authority.value: The Board aids the Director and Department by preparing examination subject matter, suggesting rules for examinations and hearings, submitting recommendations for efficient administration, grading examinations and reporting results, and performing other duties prescribed by the Director. It exercises its duties under the supervision of the Department.
authority.quote: The Board shall aid the Director and the Department by: (a) Preparing subject matter for examinations as provided in this Act. (b) Suggesting rules to govern examinations and hearings for suspension, revocation or reinstatement of licenses. (c) Submitting recommendations to the Director from time to time for the efficient administration of this Act. (d) Grading all tests and examinations for licenses and promptly reporting the results to the Director.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully violated any law of Illinois or any rule, regulation, or code promulgated thereunder regulating plumbing.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: A licensed apprentice plumber must be supervised by a sponsor or agent who is an Illinois licensed plumber. First and second year apprentices require direct personal supervision for all plumbing; later year apprentices require daily inspection after initial rough-in and after completion. No licensed plumber may supervise more than 2 licensed apprentice plumbers at the same time.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: "Supervision" with respect to first and second year licensed apprentice plumbers means that such apprentices must perform all designing and planning of plumbing systems and all plumbing as defined in this Act under the direct personal supervision of the sponsor or his or her agent who must also be an Illinois licensed plumber

apprentice_to_supervisor_ratio_regulated.quote: No licensed plumber shall sponsor more than 2 licensed apprentice plumbers at the same time.
